claim: Every one of the 440 SHA-verified original named fpw_* embedded RS source payloads has a 64-byte initial window followed by an exact multiple of 12 bytes: 24384 twelve-byte source blocks in total. In every source, the final unsigned byte of the 16-byte source vector at offsets +48..+63 exactly equals (embedded payload byte length minus 64) divided by 12. Each strictly positive cumulative vector increment defines a source-block span starting at the preceding vector value (initially zero), and for all 1347 positive increments the step value is exactly 1 plus the original source byte located at offset 64 + 12 * preceding vector value; equal consecutive vector values yield zero source-block span. All 440 source blocks are accounted for with zero mismatches, 5693 zero-step vector positions, and original-indexed source rows SHA256 c279e823a914f4221fb3d0124db6b924bc4733da1c81f3a6684e7c44cb92edfa and flattened 1347 block-span rows SHA256 6b5ad7b0a954a5e304ed9493a257c0caeecd91c20efe60b6d83bd9b210bede49. The matching original DLL separately proves that its first executed WrestlerAnmData entry reads relative input offset+64 to source-named field formNum, but does not establish GetAnmNum outputs or a runtime loading/parsing/playback association for these particular source payloads. These are exact original byte boundaries, not invented animation frames or transform/timing semantics.
